intro: Bal'lal Ruins are ancient Gurubashi troll ruins set along the northwestern shore of Stranglethorn Vale, just north of Grom'gol Base Camp. Overlooking the murky waters of the Vile Reef, the crumbling stone foundations are currently occupied by hostile Bloodscalp trolls.

sections.t: A Crumbling Outpost on the Reef
p: Perched on the coastline north of Grom'gol Base Camp, Bal'lal Ruins stand as another remnant of the shattered Gurubashi Empire. Once part of the grand troll civilization that dominated southern Azeroth, the site has decayed into moss-covered stone walls and cracked masonry. The ruins sit immediately adjacent to the Vile Reef, offering an elevated vantage over the treacherous coastal shallows. Today, aggressive Bloodscalp trolls hold the grounds, fiercely defending the weathered relics of their ancestors against intruders.
